_key.description: Orphanet disease term key and Ensembl gene ID joined by an underscore.

_from.description: Handle of the Orphanet disease term.

_to.description: Handle of the Ensembl gene Orphanet associates with the disease.

inverse_name.description: Predicate for the gene-to-disease direction. Identical to name; the relationship is symmetric.

pmids.description: PubMed identifiers Orphanet cites as the source of validation for this association.

term_name.description: Orphanet preferred name of the disease.

gene_symbol.description: HGNC symbol of the associated gene.

association_type.description: Orphanet label for the role of the gene in the disease.

association_status.description: Orphanet status of the gene–disease relationship, as written in the XML.

source.description: Orphanet, via the Orphadata gene–disease product.

source_url.description: Orphadata page for the gene–disease download.

class.description: Evidence tier for the underlying data, taken from the file's fileset metadata.

method.description: How the association was assigned, taken from the file's fileset metadata.

label.description: Same value as method, taken from the file's fileset metadata.

files_filesets.description: Handle of the files_filesets record for the IGVF file the Orphadata XML was read from.

accessible_via.return: pmids, term_name, gene_symbol, association_type, association_status, class, method, label, files_filesets, source, source_url
